facts.text: Heavy-truck experience warns against copying passenger-car AEB tests.
facts.quote: Heavy-truck experience warns against copying passenger-car tests.

facts.text: NHTSA started with light-vehicle AEB procedures and had to modify them for longer heavy-truck stopping distances and test-target towing equipment.
facts.quote: NHTSA started from light-vehicle AEB procedures and had to alter them for longer stopping distances and test-target towing equipment

facts.text: Early heavy-truck automatic braking systems did not brake for a stopped lead vehicle.
facts.quote: early heavy systems did not brake for a stopped lead vehicle

facts.text: A 2021 Freightliner Cascadia avoided a stopped target at 40 to 85 km/h, but not below 40 km/h.
facts.quote: a 2021 Freightliner Cascadia avoided a stopped target at 40 to 85 km/h but not below 40 km/h

facts.text: Moving road-based automatic braking to quarry surfaces, slopes, berms, articulated frames and airborne dust is a larger step than transferring passenger-car tests to heavy trucks.
facts.quote: Moving from roads to quarry surfaces, slopes, berms, articulated frames and airborne dust is a larger step again.

facts.text: Off-road automatic braking is commercially available, but every published operating envelope is narrow.
facts.quote: Off-road automatic braking is on the market, but every published envelope is narrow.

facts.text: Volvo CE's wheel-loader automatic braking system, dated January 2023, operates only in reverse at 3 to 15 km/h and brakes for 2 to 3 seconds.
facts.quote: Volvo CE's wheel-loader system (January 2023) works only in reverse, only at 3 to 15 km/h, and brakes for 2 to 3 seconds

facts.text: Caterpillar, Komatsu, Liebherr, John Deere, Hexagon, Epiroc and Sandvik describe off-road automatic braking systems that are reverse-only, low-speed or tag-dependent.
facts.quote: Caterpillar, Komatsu, Liebherr, John Deere, Hexagon, Epiroc and Sandvik describe reverse-only, low-speed or tag-dependent systems.

facts.text: Off-road automatic braking makers publicly disclose camera weaknesses in dusk, dawn, overcast conditions, snow, rain and fog.
facts.quote: Makers publicly disclose camera weaknesses in dusk, dawn, overcast, snow, rain and fog

facts.text: Komatsu requires its stop function to be switched off during trailer loading because a rapid stop can destabilize the machine.
facts.quote: Komatsu requires its stop function to be switched off during trailer loading because a rapid stop can destabilize the machine.

facts.text: No independent performance test was found for the off-road automatic braking systems described by Volvo CE, Caterpillar, Komatsu, Liebherr, John Deere, Hexagon, Epiroc and Sandvik.
facts.quote: No independent performance test of any of them was found.

facts.text: Off-road automatic braking validation remains far more physical than the automotive state of the art.
facts.quote: Off-road validation remains far more physical than the automotive state of the art.

facts.text: The University of Pretoria's collision-avoidance verification process progresses from laboratory tests to interaction tests in a representative mine.
facts.quote: The University of Pretoria's collision-avoidance verification process progresses from laboratory tests to interaction tests in a representative mine

facts.text: Hexagon's current Vehicle Intervention System passed Pretoria's TRL4 verification in March 2026 before integrated site testing.
facts.quote: Hexagon's current Vehicle Intervention System passed Pretoria's TRL4 verification in March 2026 before integrated site testing

facts.text: An earlier generation of Hexagon's Vehicle Intervention System accumulated more than 10,000 hours of working-mine testing.
facts.quote: an earlier generation accumulated more than 10,000 hours of working-mine testing.

facts.text: Wabtec's Level 9 integration on Komatsu haul trucks in December 2021 still relied on physical tests to adjust detection zones.
facts.quote: Wabtec's Level 9 integration on Komatsu haul trucks (December 2021) still relied on physical tests to adjust detection zones.

facts.text: No standards body or industry group has studied whether on-road simulation methods transfer to off-road machines.
facts.quote: No standards body or industry group has studied whether on-road simulation methods transfer to off-road machines.

facts.text: ISO 21815 for earth-moving machinery, ISO 18497 for agriculture and the South African mining regulations define what to test and physical test procedures, but not how much testing may be virtual.
facts.quote: ISO 21815 (earth-moving), ISO 18497 (agriculture) and the South African mining regulations define what to test and physical test procedures, not how much may be virtual.

facts.text: VaViM, conducted from February to August 2022, studied virtual-model validation for autonomous vehicles in fenced areas and is identified as the nearest precedent for transferring on-road simulation methods to off-road machines.
facts.quote: The nearest precedent, VaViM (February to August 2022), studied virtual-model validation for autonomous vehicles in fenced areas

facts.text: VaViM concluded that validated models and real tests must be used side by side.
facts.quote: concluded that validated models and real tests must be used side by side.

facts.text: The existing warning-only fleet is identified as the best available lever for off-road braking validation.
facts.quote: The best lever available is the existing warning-only fleet.

facts.text: No public case was found of an off-road maker using shadow-mode data from a warning system to certify a braking system.
facts.quote: No public case was found of an off-road maker using shadow-mode data from a warning system to certify a braking system

facts.text: Liebherr, Caterpillar and John Deere already log warning events and locations, so a data path exists for using warning-fleet data in braking validation.
facts.quote: Liebherr, Caterpillar and John Deere already log warning events and locations, so the data path exists.
